# LLM Wiki Architecture & Knowledge Compounding

Andrej Karpathy proposed the LLM Wiki workflow where raw notes are continuously compiled into structured, interlinked wiki pages rather than left as raw documents for ad-hoc RAG retrieval.

When paired with Google Open Knowledge Format (OKF-v0.3), every concept, case study, and piece of evidence becomes both human-readable in Obsidian and machine-verifiable via deterministic linters.

Key insight: Knowledge Compounding happens when each new source updates existing concept pages instead of creating isolated silos.
